budget.rationale: Notification history is actively retained for 90 days and the SQLite working set is bounded to 2 GiB by the scenario maintenance pass.

notification-db.rationale: Durable notifications, recipient projections, routing decisions, delivery attempts, receipts, and conversation state.

notification-db-wal.rationale: SQLite write-ahead log sidecar for the durable notification database.

notification-db-shm.rationale: SQLite shared-memory sidecar for the durable notification database.

budget.rationale: Lifecycle deployment report retained as owner data and budgeted by age.

deployment-report.rationale: The lifecycle deployment report is written under the scenario data root.

budget.rationale: The encoded P-256 VAPID private key is a single small stable secret; size bounds catch accidental replacement with unrelated data without rotating subscriptions.

vapid-private-key.rationale: Scenario-owned VAPID private key used to authenticate encrypted Web Push deliveries; the public half is returned to the authenticated UI and the private half never leaves state storage.

budget.rationale: Control-plane retention enforcement receipts are small, regenerable operational state bounded by size and age.

retention-receipts.rationale: The storage manager records retention enforcement receipts under the scenario-owned state namespace.

storage.rationale: The scenario owns one SQLite database and its WAL/SHM sidecars through the api-core storage resolver.

service.name: notification-hub
service.description: Owner-facing notification spine that routes alerts to the right device and channel, relaying through the fleet when this host cannot deliver

scenario-authenticator.runtime_only_rationale: Identity is verified locally against the authenticator's published JWKS through packages/api-core/owneridentity. The authenticator is resolved by slug at runtime over HTTP; no Go package from that scenario is imported here, so no import-graph edge exists.
scenario-authenticator.degraded_behavior: Authenticated surfaces fail closed when the authenticator is unreachable: the API rejects requests it cannot attribute to a verified identity. Already-accepted notifications continue to drain through the delivery worker, because their recipient was resolved at acceptance time.
scenario-authenticator.description: Owner identity for every authenticated API, CLI, and UI surface. This scenario issues no API key and stores no password.

tunnel-manager.runtime_only_rationale: Public exposure is reconciled by tunnel-manager against the core-set authority. This scenario imports no tunnel-manager Go package; it only requires that its own origin stays reachable and stable.
tunnel-manager.degraded_behavior: Without tunnel-manager, no new device can subscribe to push and the push channel reports unavailable with a stated reason. Already-registered subscriptions continue to receive deliveries while the origin remains resolvable. No local channel is affected.
tunnel-manager.description: Stable, never-expiring public origin for the installed progressive web app. A Web Push subscription is bound to an origin and dies with it.

vrooli-bridge.runtime_only_rationale: Cross-node delivery is handed to Bridge durable dispatch across its API boundary. Node capability data is read from the same surface. No Bridge Go package is imported here.
vrooli-bridge.degraded_behavior: Without Bridge, the hub delivers only channels this host can reach itself and marks every host-bound channel unroutable with a stated reason. It never silently holds a notification it cannot deliver.
vrooli-bridge.description: Fleet node registry and durable dispatch for cross-node delivery relay.

vrooli-events.runtime_only_rationale: Event ingress is inbound: vrooli-events POSTs to this scenario's webhook receiver, and subscriptions are managed across its API boundary. No events Go package is imported here.
vrooli-events.degraded_behavior: Without vrooli-events, event-driven ingress is unavailable and the hub accepts direct Connect-RPC and CLI requests only. No notification path that was working stops working.
vrooli-events.description: Event-driven ingress via durable subscription webhook delivery.
